starting_workspace.sources/01-architecture.md:
# Execution architecture

Current supported execution surfaces are **local workstation** and **GitHub Actions**. A remote VM runner is not currently a supported Series 1 surface. Local runs obtain provider credentials from the process environment. GitHub runs obtain the same provider credential from an Actions secret.
starting_workspace.sources/02-meeting-2026-07-12.md:
# Meeting note — 2026-07-12

We may add a remote VM runner later if repeated experiments need a long-lived host. This was discussed as a possible future extension; no acceptance or implementation decision was made.
starting_workspace.sources/03-validation-2026-08-01.md:
# Validation log — 2026-08-01

The harness was exercised successfully on a local workstation and on a clean GitHub-hosted runner. The remote VM path has not been tested. Functional records match structurally across the two validated surfaces. We have not yet established whether GitHub-hosted runner variance materially distorts latency comparisons against local runs.

history.content:
Research note — Series 1 execution surfaces (workspace-sourced only)

1) Currently supported execution surfaces
Two surfaces are supported: the local workstation and GitHub Actions. A remote VM runner is explicitly not a supported Series 1 surface at present. [sources/01-architecture.md]

2) Evidence establishing this
- Architectural statement: 01-architecture.md names local workstation and GitHub Actions as the supported surfaces, and details credential handling per surface — local runs draw provider credentials from the process environment; GitHub runs draw the same credential from an Actions secret. [sources/01-architecture.md]
- Empirical validation: the validation log records the harness exercised successfully on a local workstation and on a clean GitHub-hosted runner, with functional records matching structurally across the two validated surfaces. [sources/03-validation-2026-08-01.md]

3) Superseded statement
The early plan's assumption that "Series 1 will run locally only because CI cannot carry the required model configuration" is superseded. That file predates the Actions dispatcher and is retained only as planning history. [sources/99-archive-early-plan.md; contradicted by sources/01-architecture.md and confirmed operationally by sources/03-validation-2026-08-01.md]

4) Unresolved: comparing runs
It is not yet established whether GitHub-hosted runner variance materially distorts latency comparisons against local runs. Cross-surface structural equivalence is confirmed, but cross-surface latency comparability is an open question. [sources/03-validation-2026-08-01.md]

Context: a remote VM runner was discussed on 2026-07-12 as a possible future extension for long-lived experiment hosts, with no acceptance or implementation decision made; the remote VM path remains untested. [sources/02-meeting-2026-07-12.md; sources/03-validation-2026-08-01.md]

All claims above derive solely from the four workspace files; no workspace files were modified.
